name: card-grid
description: Centred heading over a grid of cards. Each card can carry a top image or an icon, a title, copy with inline links, and a button. Used for the contact page's Support / Sales / General Inquiry cards (heading as the page h1) and the free-trial page's template library.

anchor.description: id on the section (letters, digits, hyphens).

tone.description: Section background: white, or the soft grey of live's light sections.

look.description: Card style. default: white cards with a soft shadow. resource: the Resource Center's listing cards (resource-cards): a light-ruled card with no resting shadow, the photo in the listing's 40:21 frame, the listing's title and copy type and its wider row gap (/start-a-free-trial-email-only/).

eyebrow.description: Small uppercase label above the heading.

title.description: Heading. Line breaks are kept. Empty renders the cards alone.

title_tag.description: Heading level: h1 when the grid opens the page (contact page).

columns.description: Cards per row from 992px (two from 640px, one below).

items.description: Cards. Each: title (required), body, image (top picture URL) with image_alt / image_w / image_h, or icon (small icon URL); link_label + link_url for a button. In body, line breaks are kept, **double asterisks** bold, and [label](url) makes a link (http(s), mailto:, tel: or a path).
